name: core-platform-site
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && { nvm use 22 >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm install 22; } && node -v && npm ci

terminals.name: dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && { nvm use 22 >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm install 22; } && npm run dev
